body_markdown:
Hello, stargazers. With Mercury and Venus in retrograde, the stars are up to their old tricks. Good thing your October fragrance match is one guaranteed treat.


## ARIES:[Who is Elijah — Haze](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/who-is-elijah-haze-26538694288048)


Your creativity is on fire, but you’re definitely not in a **Haze** . Fresh ideas are coming faster than you can chase them; must be something about the orange blossom, chestnut, and smoky guaiac wood, like a witch’s bonfire for your brain, keeping those sparks flying.


## TAURUS:[ALLSAINTS — Ravaged Rose](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/allsaints-ravaged-rose-88117031353496)


An old flame may resurrect, giving spooky season a very literal ghost from the past. With All Saints’ Day waiting right after Halloween, consider **Ravaged Rose** —with Damask rose, amber woods, and cedar—your protection against anything that should’ve stayed buried.


## GEMINI:[FORVR MOOD — Not Your Type](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/forvr-mood-not-your-type-75237894029361)


Love is in the air, and suddenly **Not Your Type** is looking suspiciously like exactly your type. This provocative floral has white suede, iris petals, vanilla oud, and enough come-hither energy to keep romance haunting your general vicinity.


## CANCER:[OCTAVIA MORGAN Los Angeles — Dark Rose](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/octavia-morgan-los-angeles-dark-rose-151196968270191)


Romance runs deliciously deep, with a little dark magic working in your favor. Turns out that magic is **Dark Rose** : black rose and juicy plum cast the spell, while patchouli makes sure nobody breaks it.


## LEO:[Clean Reserve — Sun-Kissed Papaya](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/clean-reserve-sun-kissed-papaya-280085014893438)


Home is your happy haunt, with friends and family gravitating straight to your door. The kind of haunted house people actually want to get trapped in: **Sun-Kissed Papaya** fills the air with juicy papaya, coconut cream, and vanilla, making staying in feel suspiciously like a tropical escape.


## **VIRGO:[Memoire Archives — Disco Party](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/memoire-archives-disco-party-3750)**


Money magic is brewing, with a trick-or-treat bag’s worth of opportunity sweetening the pot. Once the coins start rolling in, consider the party officially scheduled: **Disco Party** brings lychee, pink dragonfruit, and sheer vanilla, matching fiscal responsibility with irresponsible dancing moves.


## LIBRA:[Michel Germain — Sugarful Pink Kiss](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/michel-germain-sugarful-pink-kiss-150728742521722)


Sugared raspberry, juicy cherry, and whipped cream kick off your latest reinvention, since the old you never stood a chance. **Sugarful Pink Kiss** is sweet enough to charm, flirty enough to cause trouble, and exactly the kind of trick-or-treat mischief the stars prescribed.


## SCORPIO:[Etat Libre d’Orange — Let’s Pretend](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/etat-libre-d%60orange-let-s-pretend-197175546548072)


Step out of the shadows because Scorpio season is summoning you into the spotlight. And **Let’s Pretend?** Please. Scorpio doesn’t pretend! The juicy peach, saffron, and warm woods can handle the theatrics while you simply show up and tell the truth everyone else was avoiding.


## SAGITTARIUS:[Lake & Skye — 222](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/lake-skye-222-219677267287495)


Your social calendar is frighteningly full, with invitations multiplying before your eyes. Consider 222 your angel number for saying yes to all of them: frothed milk, almond blossom, and vanilla cream make this soft skin scent one you’ll want following you everywhere.


## CAPRICORN:[Ormonde Jayne — Vanilla Aube](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/ormonde-jayne-vanilla-aube-156875094188057)


Your career takes a wicked turn for the better, with a big opportunity coming your way. **Vanilla Aube** literally means vanilla dawn, so take the hint: pistachio, cardamom, and pomegranate usher in a delicious new chapter while vanilla waits at the other end like your well-earned reward.


## AQUARIUS:[Chris Collins — LUST | Oud Delice](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/chris-collins-lust-4004)


Wanderlust has you under its spell like a witch who can’t sit still on Halloween night, even if Mercury adds a detour or two. When wander *lust* becomes plain old **LUST** , follow the trail of dark chocolate, hazelnut, and oud wherever it leads! We know you weren’t planning on taking the boring route anyway.


## PISCES:[Lavanila — Pure Vanilla](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/lavanila-pure-vanilla-977355)


Adventure is calling your name, but your wallet may have other travel plans. Fine. Skip the costume shopping and let **Pure Vanilla** do the traveling for you. Madagascar vanilla, tonka bean, and heliotrope make a pretty convincing case for taking a scentcation instead.
